summary.name: Datacircle
summary.one_liner: Datacircle is a comparison site that lists GTM (go-to-market) data APIs, showing price, cost on no match, rate limits, response time, and fields returned for each plan, with benchmark scores.
use_cases: Choosing a LinkedIn profile API for sales prospecting
Comparing email finder and verification API prices
Estimating cost of enrichment calls per 1,000 items
Finding a company headcount or funding data API
Connecting an MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
summary.what_it_does: The page is a comparison table of GTM data APIs, with one row per API plan. Each row lists the price, cost when a record is not found, rate limits, typical response time, and the fields returned. It also ranks providers within categories such as LinkedIn profile, email finder, phone finder, company enrichment, job postings and web search, using benchmark scores (overall, price, data, performance). Some rows include the terms of service excerpts for each provider. The site also states it offers an MCP server at api.datacircle.dev/mcp that can be added to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor without a key.
notable: Per-plan comparison rows showing price, not-found cost, rate limits and response time
Benchmark scores for overall, price, data, and performance across providers
MCP server at api.datacircle.dev/mcp with no key required, per the listing
Category rankings such as best LinkedIn profile API and best email finder API in 2026
caveats: Provider terms excerpted in the table show restrictions on caching, resale and commercial use that vary by provider
Prices and rankings are as shown on the page and may change; the page does not state a date for the data beyond '2026'
